answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 767 Country: ZA Title: How must a muslim person treat his parents if they are murtad? Question: How must a muslim person treat his parents if they are murtad? Answer ID: 767 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 252-252=L) If parents of a Muslim turn murtad (apostate) he should neither have a relation with them nor eat or drink with them: ولاترکنوا الی الذین ظلموا فتمسکم النار الآیہ وفی الکشاف: والنہی متناول لہ الخطاط والانقطاع الیہم ومصاحبتہم ومجالستہم الخ (الکشاف: ۲/۲۹۶) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
